svg.text: ① INDEXING: how RBI rules get in
background worker · Redis Streams job queue · daily 06:30 IST · retries · dead-letter queue

g.text: one database for text, versions, keyword search and vectors
③ ANSWERING: how a question gets a checked answer
reads (only rules in force that day)
hit → answer in ~5 ms, no LLM call
④ CHANGE TRACKING: what changed, and why it matters
uses the LLM gateway + hybrid search
quotes are checked word for word in code · impact: what changed, who is affected, what to do
→ shown in the UI "Recent changes", GET /changes and the MCP tool recent_changes
